increment_status: Public heterogeneous print and borrowed source-console bindings implemented; frozen-source focused Linux Debug/strict acceptance passed. Native Windows/macOS and final-stage acceptance remain UNVERIFIED.
implemented: Compiler-recognized heterogeneous print pack; named-only sep/end/file/flush, existing argument binding/shadowing, no general varargs or object array. All explicit values/controls snapshot once in written order before left-to-right shared display hooks and checked whole-record assembly. Bare null display allocation is deferred until rendering.

Existing numeric, nominal/custom, generic, temporal and opaque-resource display reused. Unicode/NUL preserved, no outer record before successful rendering; nested hook prints run outside outer gate. Composite collections/enums/results remain explicitly unsupported.

Protected compiler-owned console.input/output roles and stdlib stdin/stdout/stderr. Endpoint copies, safe declared defaults, repeated templates, initializer authority and generic storage preserve real construction readiness. Forged creation/payload writes/roles and uninitialized loads reject independently; no native source handles.

Ordinary source recoverable write/write_bytes/flush/is_redirected and read_bytes/read_char/read_text/read_line wrappers. Shared native queue/decoder/deadlines/CRLF/EOF retained; readonly io_error includes operation, stream, kind, native code, message, exact byte progress, partial bytes, cleanup code and partial UTF16 units.

New private typed operations reuse existing compiler/LLVM Runtime ABI, exact JIT binding and linked Runtime archive. Native bytes owned before NativeSafe blocking, existing record serialization, Runtime cancellation/lifetime and worker restrictions. console-v1 compatibility identity; installed stdlib path/source protections reused.

Small supporting repairs: intrinsic const-field projection assignability, writable synthetic collection-count diagnostic, rich checked-failure propagation, and endpoint default construction/pure-factory classification. Existing readonly/private/worker/IR checks and legacy CLI result printing preserved.

strict_sanitizers.configuration: RelWithDebInfo with pinned LLVM/Clang 19.1.7; existing RTTI-off vptr exclusion unchanged
strict_sanitizers.execution: LeakSanitizer actually executed outside the restricted ptrace runner; no sanitizer report in final focused acceptance.

coverage: Six native source fixtures in normal/O2 JIT and independently linked normal/O2 AOT, binary stdout/stderr comparisons retained as hex, including Unicode/NUL/raw invalid bytes.
All controls and evaluation counts/order, old value versus shared managed identity, generic/temporal/custom displays, hook/native failures and reached cleanup.
Forced GC at allocation budget one, blocking native output while collecting, persistent and one-shot allocation failure sweeps with root/frame cleanup.
All portable recoverable error kinds and native/cleanup/partial-UTF16 progress, real POSIX broken pipe checked rather than SIGPIPE termination.
Private/const endpoints, worker effects/recursive transfer and malformed IR; selected const-field/read-only mutable-path negatives.
Installed stdlib resolution and canonical identity, standalone private-op rejection, cold/hit/corrupt/source-changed cache paths, preserved operator/display generation/reload tests.

unresolved_observations: One early current-revision publication assertion failed without further diagnostics. It did not reproduce with explicit contract checks or a minimal variant without them. A later final-source default-root run failed operator_reload and temporal_ir with _year/year library diagnostics; original library bytes subsequently matched the baseline, and isolated, explicit-original-root and default-root reruns passed. External interference is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Final acceptance uses the exact baseline library in a verified isolated root. No check was disabled; these earlier observations remain unexplained and retained for independent review.
